# Business Insider

> Business Insider covers workforce transformation, AI adoption in hiring, and future-of-work trends shaping the global labor market.

Business Insider provides in-depth analysis of hiring trends, skills-first employment strategies, and AI's impact on workforce development. The publication leverages reporting from Indeed Hiring Lab and coverage of major industry events like BI Live and Davos to deliver insights on labor market innovation.

## Key Topics

- AI in workforce
- Skills-first hiring
- Workforce transformation
- Future of work
- Hiring trends
- Labor market
- Job market innovation
- Employer strategies
- Business Insider
- Indeed Hiring Lab

## Workforce & AI Trends

- [Introducing the Better Work Project Hub](https://www.businessinsider.com/sc/introducing-the-better-work-project-hub): Hub exploring AI, skills-first hiring, and workforce transformation trends
